summary: Wrote a 7-phase plan containing the regression-anchor source-store mutation. The containment is a reorder of the one unsafe call site: call setup_sandbox() first, then apply the identical sed to $SUT instead of $CORE_DIR, so the shared source store is never written and the backup/trap/restore machinery becomes unnecessary. Paired with a new source-store-scoped residue detector (anchored-start `while false &&` guard plus leftover *.anchor-bak), registered as gate 28 with its own suite, in-suite byte-identity and residue invariants, and a safe-pattern rule added to the testing standard. Premise re-validation found the declared must-land-first territory edge (328) already completed and archived, so the task is unblocked.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase containment plan: anchor-mutation reorder onto the sandbox copy, in-suite source-store invariants, a gate-28 residue detector with its own suite, and a safe-pattern rule in the testing standard.
